{
  set -x
  echo '== is the server up right now, with no restart? =='
  curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'index=%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/simple/vectorops/
  curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'whl=%{http_code}\n'  http://localhost:8080/packages/vectorops-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
  curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'sdist=%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/packages/vectorops-0.1.0.tar.gz
  echo '== wheel contents (must contain vectorops/__init__.py) =='
  python3 -m zipfile -l packages/vectorops-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
  echo '== exact acceptance command, fresh venv =='
  rm -rf /tmp/vz && python3 -m venv /tmp/vz
  /tmp/vz/bin/pip install --index-url http://localhost:8080/simple vectorops==0.1.0
  cd /tmp && /tmp/vz/bin/python -c "from vectorops import dotproduct; assert 1 == dotproduct([1,1], [0,1]); assert 32 == dotproduct([1,2,3],[4,5,6]); assert 11.0 == dotproduct([1.5,2.0],[2.0,4.0]); assert 0 == dotproduct([], []); print('ACCEPT_OK')"
  echo '== installed metadata =='
  /tmp/vz/bin/pip show vectorops | head -3
  /tmp/vz/bin/python -c "import vectorops; print('FROM', vectorops.__file__)"
  echo '== negative control: wrong version must not resolve =='
  /tmp/vz/bin/pip install --no-cache-dir --index-url http://localhost:8080/simple vectorops==0.1.1
  echo "EXPECTED_FAILURE_EXIT=$?"
} > /app/.gnomon-jobs/final.log 2>&1
